create_better_networking.configuration.s: Show the web’s mark in the heads-up view
Show the web’s mark in the clipboard’s lit-block view when the web has no name
create_better_networking.frequency.contr: Shift-left-click to write down; left-click to put in. To name a web, add a clipboard line holding only #network: Link Series.
create_better_networking.frequency.empty: No waveband kept. Shift-left-click a linked block to write one down.
create_better_networking.frequency.inact: That workshop gauge board is asleep
create_better_networking.frequency.prote: You are not allowed to change that web
create_better_networking.frequency.same: That block already works on this waveband
create_better_networking.frequency.clien: Client only: Shift-left-click to select; Shift-left-click air to clear. Selection lasts until disconnect.
create_better_networking.frequency.serve: Applying networks requires Better Networking on the server.
